q: Who can join IEEE CIS REC?
a: Any student at Rajalakshmi Engineering College, from any department and any year. You don't need to be an AI expert, just curious.

q: Do I need to be an IEEE member to attend events?
a: Registration details are listed on each event page. Check there, or message us on Instagram if you're unsure.
IEEE sets the student membership fee, and it changes over time. Check the current rate on the IEEE website before you sign up.

q: How do I join one of the domain teams?
a: Domain teams such as ML, Data Science, Computer Vision, IoT and Web Development recruit through the chapter. Watch our Instagram and LinkedIn for announcements.

q: Can I propose a workshop or talk?
a: Yes. Email us with the topic, who would run it, and roughly when. Student-led sessions are welcome.
